name: portal-intro
title: Portal Intro
description: Sentence-to-picture intro. The lead words fade up one at a time, the line re-sets with a small rounded picture chip inside it and leans in until the chip takes the frame; a title types itself over the picture, lifts away, and the mark and the name arrive. Fitted frame by frame from a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/portal-intro?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame; the picture, title and mark are props. — 82 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
